description:
Quote Runway Ruby SDR-to-HDR conversion (model="ruby") in RUB; nothing is charged.

Required video_url must be an owned SDR video (<= 30 s, < 4096 px per side; HDR inputs are rejected
before charging). Supports 6 output_format values: hdr10 (default, .mp4), hlg (.mp4), hdr_prores (.mov,
prores_profile 422 | "422 HQ" | 4444), hdr_exr_sequence (.zip), hdr_exr_acescg_sequence_1_3 (.zip),
and hdr_exr_acescg_sequence_2_0 (.zip). Rate depends on frame area (<= 4 MP vs > 4 MP).

output_format.description: HDR output format: hdr10, hlg, hdr_prores, hdr_exr_sequence, hdr_exr_acescg_sequence_1_3, or hdr_exr_acescg_sequence_2_0.
output_format.title: Output Format

prores_profile.description: ProRes profile when output_format='hdr_prores' ('422', '422 HQ', or '4444').
prores_profile.title: Prores Profile

video_url.description: Owned Arckep storage key or URL of an SDR source video (<=30 s, <4096 px per side, <=200 MB).
video_url.title: Video Url

name: estimate_video_hdr
